requirements.label: 120 Total Credits
requirements.hint: The BFA in Dance requires a minimum of 120 credits. Requirements follow the 2024-2025 Silent Advisor; SMTD students follow the curriculum of their admit year.

requirements.label: Non-SMTD credits (30)
requirements.hint: At least 30 credits outside SMTD. Courses within Arts Administration also count as non-SMTD.

requirements.label: Physical Practice/Technique (32 credits)
requirements.hint: 32 credits of technique, including at least 2 credits each in Modern, Ballet, Improvisation, World, and Somatic Practice, with a minimum of 4th year level reached in at least one method. Physical Practice may also include Dance Lab credits and a maximum of 3 credits from Dance courses offered in Musical Theatre.

requirements.label: Dance Repertory (4 credits if cast)
requirements.hint: Minimum 4 credits if cast, from Sophomore, Junior, and Senior Repertory or the MFA Thesis. Up to 2 additional credits of Repertory may be used toward Physical Practice/Technique.

requirements.label: Dance Composition (8 credits)
requirements.hint: Minimum 8 credits from Composition I-IV or Advanced Dance Making.

requirements.label: Dance History (9 credits)
requirements.hint: Minimum 9 credits from Art of Dance, Dance and Society, World Dance, Dancing Cities, Africanist Traditions, Dancing Women/Dancing Queer, or Writing Dancing.

requirements.label: Additional Dance requirements (8 courses)
requirements.hint: Freshman Touring Company, Anatomy and Physiology for Dancers, Kinesiology for Dancers, First Year Seminar, Integration of Music and Movement, Sophomore Seminar, Dance Production, and Senior Seminar.

requirements.label: Teaching Methods
requirements.hint: Teaching Methods, listed as Dance 481/482 on the Silent Advisor; the current catalog carries Teaching Methods as DANCE 381 and 382.

requirements.label: Senior Concert (4 credits)
requirements.hint: DANCE 493/494 Senior Concert, 4 credits in the final year.

requirements.label: THTREMUS 251: Run Crew
requirements.hint: One credit of Theatre Run Crew.

requirements.label: SMTD electives (6 credits)
requirements.hint: Minimum 6 credits made up from Musicology, Music Theory, Performance, or Ensemble courses, and one Theatre course other than 251. The audit counts any non-Dance SMTD course here.

requirements.label: Theatre course
requirements.hint: One Theatre course other than THTREMUS 251, which is separately required. The first Theatre election is reserved for 251.

requirements.label: First year writing
requirements.hint: ENGLISH 124, 125, or an equivalent first year writing course.

requirements.label: Upper level writing
requirements.hint: An upper level writing course approved by the Sweetland Writing Center.

requirements.label: Race and Ethnicity course
requirements.hint: One course in Race and Ethnicity selected from approved courses within LSA, or within SMTD by petition. SMTD RE courses will not count into overall non-SMTD credits.

requirements.label: History of Art elective
requirements.hint: One History of Art course, 3 to 4 credits.
